''With apologies to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AEuFaRBGDcw The Animals] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_House_of_the_Rising_Sun Appalachia], I present ''The Land of the Rising Sun'' as written by [[Thom Merrilin]].''

There is a land called [[Cairhien]]<br />
They call the Rising Sun<br />
And it's been the ruin of many a poor man<br />
And Light, I know I'm one

[[Dena]] was a gleewoman<br />
She met Halen’s [[Loial|grandson]]<br />
Then went to fetch knives from [[Ivon (blacksmith)|Ivon]]<br />
Down in Cairhien

Now the only thing this [[Gleeman|gleeman]] needs<br />
Is a knife and a [[The Great Hunt/Chapter 34|pawn]]<br />
And the only thing that will satisfy<br />
Is the fall of [[Galldrian Riatin|Galldrian]]

Oh, mother, tell your children<br />
Not to do what I have done<br />
Spend your lives free of [[Daes Dae'mar]]<br />
and land of the Rising Sun.

Well, I got one hand on the ship's rail<br />
My feet hanging down the stern<br />
I'm goin' back to [[Caemlyn]] town<br />
To see what time has earned.

Well, there is a land called Cairhien<br />
They call the Rising Sun<br />
And it's been the ruin of many a poor man<br />
And Light, I know I'm one
